mass_gross.note: Manual p13 leaves 'L'avion etant au poids de' blank. Alternatives: 2785 kg max take-off (Wikipedia), 2800 kg (warbirdsresourcegroup).

n_limit_pos.source: CS-23 aerobatic category limit load factor (+6.0 g)
n_limit_pos.note: The manual gives no load factor and none was found for the D.520. Results are also given per g and as the load factor at which each failure mode is reached, so any other requirement can be applied.

n_limit_neg.source: CS-23 aerobatic category negative limit load factor (-0.5 x positive)

CL_design.source: clean CL at the manoeuvre point (only shapes the small 'basic' part of the span loading)

a0_section.source: section lift slope 0.9 x 2 pi (thick sections)

alpha0_tip.source: NACA 230-series zero-lift angle (Abbott & von Doenhoff, 23012: -1.2 deg)
alpha0_tip.note: Root section is symmetric (Pl.1 rib table); camber blended from rib 21 to the tip as in the 3-D model (GUESS blend).

rib_stations_y.source: Pl.1 front elevation (PDF p68): ribs numbered 22 (root) to 1 (tip), 396 px/m
rib_stations_y.note: Rib 22 = 0.51 m, rib 16 = 1.50 m (dihedral break), rib 13 = 2.07 m, rib 1 = 4.93 m.

spar_x_c.source: Pl.1 root section (0.371c), Pl.6 rib 13 (0.35-0.40c), Pl.1 plan (0.35-0.385c)
spar_x_c.note: Single I-section main spar (PRINTED p13: 'a) un longeron unique').

false_spar_x_c.source: Pl.6 rib 13 (0.73c); Pl.1 root section (0.705c); 1 - flap chord fraction 0.25 (p14)

flange_root_width.source: Pl.1 root section, hatched spar boom: ~40 px along the chord at 352 px/m (low confidence)

flange_root_thickness.source: Pl.1 root section, hatched spar boom: ~11 px normal to the skin (low confidence, +/-30%)

flange_taper.source: Manual p13: 'Les semelles vont en diminuant d'epaisseur et de largeur le long de l'envergure' (PRINTED, qualitative). Width taken proportional to chord, thickness = area / width.

tank_y.source: Pl.5 'Jonction 13' (tank ends at rib 13) + capacity 122 l fits the D-nose from rib 13 to rib 7
tank_y.note: Outboard end is an inference from volume.

tank_volume.source: p.11 bis (handwritten): 'Capacite du reservoir gauche 122, droit 122'

guns_y.source: Pl.50 bis (PDF p145/148) gun positions, as in the 3-D model

rounds_per_gun.source: p38: '650 cartouches par arme'; p41: 'chargeurs ... 650 cartouches'

round_mass.source: 7.5x54 MAS round ~23 g (9.0 g bullet, Wikipedia) plus belt link

wheel_well.source: Pl.1 plan 'Passage de la roue' circle: centre y 0.30 m (= retracted wheel of the 3-D model), 0.17c behind LE, radius 0.37 m

fitting_y.source: fuselage side at the wing upper surface (Pl.0 fuselage width law), where the D fittings of Pl.14 join spar and frame
fitting_y.note: Manual p14: 3 attachments of the spar upper part to frame I, 2 of the false spar to frame III; all fittings high-tensile steel.

E.note: Manual p13: all wing parts duralumin except the fishplates (PRINTED).

Ftu.source: 2017-T4 tensile strength, minimum of quoted 380-425 MPa

zones.source: 6 spanwise gauge zones bounded by ribs 21, 16, 12, 8, 4 (sheet gauges step at ribs)

t_skin.source: smooth stressed skin ('revetement en tole lisse', p13); gauges typical of 1938-40 fighters

t_spar_web.source: 'ame en tole forte' (thick sheet web, p13)

stringer.source: spanwise rivet rows on the skin of Pl.2 indicate stringers; 4 blade stringers per surface between the spars
